personality_one_liner: A premium, trustworthy, and highly accessible digital utility for rural communities, prioritizing clarity and ease of use.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing to ensure large, accessible touch targets for 18-60+ demographic. Use consistent 16px/24px margins.

do's: Avoid glassmorphism to maintain maximum contrast and readability for older rural users.
dont's: Do not use blur or glass effects on critical UI elements or cards.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app's value and set the user's preferred language (English/Telugu) seamlessly.
screens.layout: Full-bleed rural imagery at the top with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. The bottom 40% houses a white surface container with large typography, language toggle pills, and a prominent sticky 'Continue' button.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary discovery hub for all village utilities with immediate access to critical services.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and search bar.

screens.layout: Top section: Location selector ('📍 Patavala' + 'Kakinada district, AP') placed prominently. Large search bar ('What do you need?') with rotating placeholders. Below: A generous 2-column grid (`flexWrap: 'wrap'`, `justifyContent: 'space-between'`, `gap: md`) of 8 large rounded quick-action cards. Cards should have a tinted icon (`brandTertiary` background) and dark charcoal text. No dense dashboard layouts.

screens.name: Emergency
screens.purpose: Instant access to critical emergency services with an accessible, high-contrast interface.

states.error: Clear network error with a persistent offline fallback text.

screens.layout: Prominent but not frightening. A 2-column grid of large red-tinted buttons (Ambulance, Police, Fire, Hospitals, Pharmacy, Blood Help) with high-contrast text and recognizable icons. A large, sticky 'CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES' CTA anchored at the bottom (outside scroll view).

screens.name: Health Directory
screens.purpose: A searchable list of nearby health resources (hospitals, pharmacies, doctors).

states.empty: Clean illustration with 'No health services found nearby.' and a CTA to clear filters.

screens.layout: Top horizontal scrollable category chip row (Hospitals, Doctors, Pharmacies, etc.). Below: Single-column list of large Business Cards. Each card includes: Name, Category, an 'Open' indicator (green dot + text), distance in km, and a bottom row of large pill buttons [Call] and [Direction]. Cards use soft shadow and large typography.

hero_village.alt: Rural landscape with flooded fields and paths, warm and inviting

village_agriculture.alt: Serene green farm fields representing agriculture

emergency_ambulance.alt: Paramedic standing inside an ambulance, ready for emergency response

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize accessibility: Use Plus Jakarta Sans, large touch targets (min 56pt), and high contrast (WCAG AA) to ensure older rural users (18-60+) can easily navigate the app.
Implement English/Telugu language toggle seamlessly. Ensure UI elements are flexible enough to handle longer Telugu text strings without breaking layout.
For the Home screen, the 8 quick-action cards must use a 2-column grid wrapping layout. The cards should feature large Phosphor icons inside `brandTertiary` tinted containers.
Emergency Screen MUST use large, red-tinted (`#FEE2E2` / `error` shade background) touch targets for the 6 primary emergency categories, and have a sticky global emergency CTA docked at the bottom.
Health business cards must prominently display a green 'Open' indicator and have dedicated [Call] and [Directions] pill buttons inside the card.
Use solid white (`surface`) and off-white (`surfaceSecondary`) cleanly. Do not use glassmorphism or dense shadows as they hinder legibility.
Apply Saffron (`#EA580C`) strictly as a small accent (e.g., notification dots, active toggles) and Green (`#16A34A`) as the primary brand color.
